title: nomimas 要件・決定事項まとめ
summary: Consolidated requirements and decisions for nomimas, a LINE bot that automates final-confirmation messaging for Twipla offline-event attendees, covering v1 scope, roadmap phases, and chosen tech stack.
scope: v1 requirements (AUTH, EVENT, LINE, ADMIN, NOTIF, OA)
notes: Hybrid document: dominant PRD signals (12 ID'd requirements AUTH-01..OA-03, v1/v2 scoping, out-of-scope table) mixed with SPEC-like tech-stack/schema tables and ADR-like 'Key Decisions' table plus a roadmap. Classified PRD because requirements/scope content dominates; design decisions are mostly marked 'Pending' (only the cheerio scraping decision is confirmed), so no locked ADR status applies. Synthesizer should still mine sections 3-4 for technical constraints/decisions and section 8 for phase mapping.
